id: W:postlethwayt|universal dictionary of trade and commerce
original_title: The universal dictionary of trade and commerce
catalogued_as: Postlethwayt, Malachy; Savary des Brûlons, Jacques
note: First issued 1751–1755, an expanded English adaptation of Savary. Identifiers refer to A. M. Kelley’s 1971 reprint of the 1774 fourth edition, not the 1751 printing; catalogue states this explicitly. No individual candidate matches; Selected works is a separate omnibus.

Eutrope is the French name of Eutropius, not a different author. ISBN identifies Joseph Hellegouarc’h’s 1999 Latin–French critical edition, Abrégé d’histoire romaine; the Latin work dates to approximately 369–370. No candidates supplied.

Orose is the French name of Orosius. ISBN identifies volume II, books IV–VI, of Marie-Pierre Arnaud-Lindet’s Latin–French edition (1991), not the whole seven-book set; the original was written in 416–417. The abbreviated citation does not establish which other volumes were consulted. No candidates supplied.
